title: Standard integral forms
description: Integrate to inverse-trigonometric and logarithmic standard forms; evaluate integrals of $\sin^2 x$ and $\cos^2 x$ using double-angle identities; recognise and apply the standard results $\int \frac{1}{\sqrt{a^2-x^2}}\,dx$ and $\int \frac{1}{a^2+x^2}\,dx$.
